annotations.text:
AVATAR (from 10xecom.ca): complete beginners - shift workers and newcomers to North America. Building alongside a job, on a tight budget. Wary of scams. Taught by someone who worked shifts and carried debt.

Site promise: "Build your Shopify business without quitting your job."
Site disclaimer: "NO INCOME GUARANTEES. THIS IS A REAL BUSINESS THAT TAKES REAL WORK."

WARNING - posts 02 to 05 are still aimed at the WRONG PERSON.

AOV / CAC / LTV and "it's not traffic, it's math" were written for experienced operators. A complete beginner working shifts does not know those acronyms and will read them as "not for me" - the opposite of what an audience filter should do here.

01 and 06 are rebuilt on the real avatar and are safe to post. 02 to 05 are not.

01 names the person without naming the product: "Still up after your shift?" filters IN rather than out, and the redaction bar introduces the device that 06 pays off.

06 keeps story 01's voice, then puts the name where the bar was. The promise is the site's own line.

The disclaimer sits on 06 deliberately - this audience is targeted by scams, so saying "no income guarantees" out loud is a trust asset.

DM keyword is 10X. Wire the auto-reply before posting.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.

The band above each CTA is deliberate sticker room.
